name: Wirehouse
description: A wirehouse was a full-service brokerage. It ran its branch offices off private telegraph lines and held Quotrons on their desk. This Wirehouse runs off a Uniswap v4 pool with private hooks. QWIRE is a treasury token that feeds Quotron. Every swap pays 3% in WETH, and 2.750 of those three points go straight back out on the High-Voltage Line, The Filament, and Trunk Line. The last 0.250 is the House Account. The QWIRE Treasury will purchase QUOTRON and hardwire terminals to produce yield. 100% of the yield will be spent to buyback and burn the QWIRE token, unless otherwise modified through governance (coming soon).
